nightly-eval-bot: Nightly eval: model=redwood-v2-quant2 failed on suite=tools-regression (312 fails). Summary: function-call JSON output contains stringified args and mixed quoting. Report: https://ci.internal/redwood/nightly/1851234567 :eyes:

maya_chen: seeing the same locally. a bunch of cases where `args` comes back as a single string instead of an object, e.g. `\"args\": \"{\\\"ids\\\": \\\"[1,2,3]\\\"}\"`

kevin_liu: ugh classic stringify-internal. Is this only on quant2?

nightly-eval-bot: breakdown by model-variant: redwood-v2-fp16: 3 fails, redwood-v2-quant2: 312 fails, redwood-v2-quant4: 298 fails. Failing pattern: serialized JSON inside `args` (string), numeric fields coerced to strings, arrays flattened to single-quoted lists.

simon: quick example from the failing payloads:
```json
{"tool":"kb_lookup","args":"{'ids':'[42,7]','max_results':'5'}","meta":"call_ok"}
```
note the single quotes and inner array as string.

julia_ng: could be our quantization-induced tokenizer change? or model sampling weirdness during function emission. any diffs in tokenizer behavior between quant2/quant4 and fp16?

kevin_liu: ran a diff of logits traces for the tool-call token region. quant2 has a spike at token 4621 (single-quote) vs fp16 prefers double-quote token. suspicious. attaching short trace snippet: `... 0.02 -> 0.47 ("') -> 0.11 ...`

maya_chen: reproducer command: `python tools/eval_runner.py --suite tools-regression --model redwood-v2-quant2 --limit 50 --seed 42 --dump-calls=out.jsonl`

maya_chen: sample failing line from out.jsonl:
`{"prompt_id": 194, "response": "CALL kb_lookup('{\'ids\': \'[42,7]\', \'max_results\': \'5\'}')"}`

simon: that makes parsing fail in prod parsers. current fallback just tries `json.loads` and then raises. we need a sanitizer that handles single->double quotes and unstringified arrays, but must be careful not to accept arbitrary broken output.

eng-runtime-bot: suggestion: add pre-parse canonicalizer in proxy that runs heuristics: 1) attempt `json.loads`, 2) if fails, try single->double quote normalize (only for top-level keys), 3) detect inner numeric strings and coerce if schema requires numbers, 4) reject if still invalid and route to model-variant fallback. Would add 4ms p95.

kevin_liu: I think fallback to fp16 (or quant4) is reasonable until we pin root cause. For immediate mitigation: route function-call traffic for production tag `tools` to redwood-v2-fp16 for 24h.

julia_ng: agree. also we should add a unit test in nightly eval to catch stringified-args pattern. PR to eval harness: add `assert isinstance(event['args'], dict)` after parsing.

maya_chen: follow-up debug: created small prompt tweak that forces explicit `"args":` delimiting with `
-- JSON START --
` marker. That reduced bad outputs in a 20-run micro-batch (50 -> 4 fails). So model generation boundary is ambiguous.

simon: can you paste the prompt diff?

maya_chen: prompt patch snippet:
```
Please return only a JSON object and nothing else.
-- JSON START --
{"tool": "kb_lookup", "args":
```
(we close after the model emits args).

kevin_liu: good temporary trick. long-term we need: 1) kernel/quant analysis to see why quoting preference changes, 2) canonicalizer + strict schema check, 3) update nightly-to-fail-on-stringified-args so we don't regress.

julia_ng: filing ticket now: ML-8463 "Quant2: function-call arg stringification and quoting drift". assigning @kevin_liu and @maya_chen. please add the failing sample ids to the ticket.

kevin_liu: added samples + trace logs. scheduling deep-dive tomorrow 11am PT. cc @simon for runtime side.

maya_chen: I'll push a small eval change PR to add the assertion and upload the 50-sample dump.

nightly-eval-bot: mitigation applied: routing override created for tag=tools -> redwood-v2-fp16 (until 2026-03-22T14:00Z) ; flagged 312 events as requiring manual triage. :white_check_mark:

simon: moving to action items: runtime canonicalizer spike (kevin), quant-lab kernel traces (maya), eval assertion + prompt patch (julia). will follow up in ML-8463. thanks all. :thumbsup:
